Lemma~\ref{lem:annulus-embedding} places $B$ in the resulting

The outside $c$--$e$ path contracts to $ce$, so the retained
graph is a nontoroidal minor and minimality gives
$G=(\Psi_3\cup B)+ce$. Since $B+bc$ is nonplanar and $K_5$-minor-free,
keep a $K_{3,3}$ subdivision and apply
Lemma~\ref{core:retained-subdivision}. The reduction preserves
all three attachments, connected interior and the failed test,
so minimality leaves $B$ unchanged.
Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction}, with added
edge $bc$, gives $563$ bridges. Every resulting graph has a
proper nontoroidal minor except one copy of $\mathfrak T_{41}$,
whose completion $B+bd+cd$ is planar~\supp{E31}. This contradicts our assumption.
